subject: [PATCH v4 01/14] NFSD: cap the number of listeners accepted in listener_set

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch limits the number of listeners accepted in the listener_set function to prevent a userland request from spinning indefinitely due to a nested loop that runs under sv_lock with bottom halves disabled. The limit is set at NFSD_NL_LISTENER_MAX (1024) entries, which is far above any realistic configuration. This change does not cap the number of existing listeners but rather prevents new requests from exceeding this threshold. The patch also adds a check in nfsd_nl_validate_listeners to reject oversized listener lists before taking any locks.
